did.unittitle: Laurance S. Rockefeller papers, Memorabilia

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. All inquiries to view memorabilia require advanced notice of at least two business days, and may necessitate notice of up to one week. Items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Primarily consists of printed material, posters, albums, scrapbooks, awards, and certificates of appreciation presented to Laurance S. Rockefeller for his philanthropic, conservation, and service activities.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - File-Level Access. Records remain in original housing and transfile box. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
